base_gsi.name: MysticGSI Samsung One UI 6.1 (Galaxy A05s SM-A057F port)

adaptations_and_root_causes.description: Removed corrupt 133-byte Git LFS pointer stubs for /system/apex/com.android.vndk.v31.apex and v32 while keeping the valid ext4 com.android.vndk.v30.apex.
Repacked /system/apex/com.samsung.android.shell.apex from EROFS payload to ext4 and signed with AVB SHA256_RSA4096 hashtree + APK Signature Scheme v2/v3 (4096-byte aligned).
Patched /system/bin/vndk-detect to check /vendor/etc/selinux/vendor_sepolicy.cil in addition to nonplat_sepolicy.cil so persist.sys.vndk=30 resolves on oem.
Patched /system/bin/bpfloader at file offset 0x1978..0x198c (0x1988: 00000000 -> 03000000) so /system/etc/bpf/ allows BPF_PROG_TYPE_SCHED_CLS (3) for semUidBPF.o, semSmartHS.o, and mnxbNetd.o.

Patched VINTF compatibility_matrix.5.xml and 4.xml (graphics.mapper 2.1 -> 2.0-1, stripped <kernel> blocks) and added <vendor-ndk><version>30</version></vendor-ndk> to system_ext/etc/vintf/manifest.xml.
Added empty 30.0.cil and 30.0.compat.cil stubs under system_ext and product SELinux mapping directories and ran offline secilc compilation verification against oem-a17-keyaki.img.
Copied audio_effects.xml to audio_effects_sec.xml and stripped STAGE_EFFECT_DOLBY lines from stage_policy.conf.

Removed /system/priv-app/SamsungDeviceHealthManagerService (vendor crashes) and /system/priv-app/KnoxGuard (com.samsung.android.kgclient triggering remote lock code 3010 when ro.product.first_api_level < 30).

Removed static Samsung Wi-Fi RRO overlays (/system/app/WifiRROverlayApp, WifiRROverlayAppH2E, WifiRROverlayJdm) that forced Connected MAC Randomization on BCM4359 brcmfmac, causing divergent interface MAC vs WifiConfigStore and WPA2 4-way handshake WRONG_KEY timeouts; restores factory hardware MAC bit (first_byte_locally_admin=0).

Uncommented AOSP ConfigFS gadget triggers in /system/etc/init/hw/init.usb.configfs.rc, set persist.sys.usb.config=adb in /system/product/etc/build.prop and /system/build.prop, appended keyaki properties + ro.opengles.version=196610, and updated /system/bin/rw-system.sh (resetprop_phh ro.adb.secure 0).
